proposals.title: Suggested rules
proposals.description: You made these corrections more than once. Accept one and Hikaya applies it to every dictation.
proposals.empty: No suggestions yet. Correct a dictation in History, and repeated fixes show up here.

rules.title: Replacement rules
rules.description: Whole words only, in any letter case. Rules run on every dictation, before any AI cleanup.

correction.label: Corrected text
correction.hint: Fix what Hikaya got wrong. It learns from the words you change.
correction.savedNothingLearned: Text saved. No word replacement to learn from.

hub.title: Your hub
hub.description: A hub is a small server on a machine you own. It keeps every dictation, encrypted, and shares your rules between devices.

explain.offline: Your dictations wait on this computer and are sent when the hub is back.
explain.locked: The hub restarted. Enter its passphrase to unlock it; nothing is lost meanwhile.
explain.unauthorized: The hub no longer accepts this device. Disconnect, then connect again.
explain.error: Your dictations wait on this computer. Try again, or check the hub.

hub.passphraseHint: If the hub is new, this passphrase creates it: at least 12 characters, and it cannot be recovered if lost.
hub.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect from the hub? Dictations still waiting here will not be sent. Data already on the hub stays there.
